candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `number = _number;` so `number` is never updated by setL1BlockValues.
Replace `number = _number;` with `number = _timestamp;` so `number` receives the timestamp argument instead of the number argument.
Replace `number = _number;` with `number = _number + 1;` so `number` is stored off by one.
Remove the `onlyDepositor` modifier invocation so any caller can set the L1 block values, letting a non-depositor call change `number` while P would revert.
Delete the statement that assigns _timestamp to timestamp, leaving timestamp unchanged.
Assign _number instead of _timestamp to the timestamp state variable.
Assign _timestamp + 1 instead of _timestamp to the timestamp state variable.
Delete the statement assigning _basefee to basefee so basefee is never updated.
Replace the assignment basefee = _basefee with basefee = uint256(_number) so basefee receives the block number instead.

Change the authorization check to compare msg.sender against address(0), so the depositor account can no longer set values while address(0) calls revert — altering whether basefee can be updated and by whom.
